groups.saying_opens: بهذا الإسناد نحو حديث ابن أبي عمر
قد ثبت حديث من يرفع يديه
كان مالك بن أنس يرى رفع اليدين
كان سفيان بن عيينة وعمر بن هارون والنضر

notes: the text is commentary: the matn of Ibn Umar's hadith is not quoted, so the first group carries the transmission only; «بهذا الإسناد» is a back_reference (no previous report supplied)
five sayings with their own isnads (rule 4a): the hadith, Ibn al-Mubarak's remark, Malik's, Ma'mar's, and Jarud's report of named scholars' practice; each is stored with its own saying number
«وقال عبد الله بن المبارك ... وذكر حديث الزهري عن سالم عن أبيه» names a chain as an example inside his remark: left out, not a route
«قال أبو عيسى» (the compiler) is not written as a transmitter; «وقال يحيى» is the same word as the earlier Yahya, not merged
